## Contract authority

- [ ] No wire behavior was invented locally.
- [ ] Proposal control documents remain `status: proposal` and `authoritative: false`; schemas/examples remain visibly proposal-scoped, or core adoption evidence is linked.
- [ ] Pinned core artifacts include release identifiers and immutable digests.
- [ ] OpenAPI/request/success/error and auxiliary schema changes agree.
- [ ] Compatibility and deprecation impact is classified.

Core evidence/adoption link:

## Architecture and security

- [ ] Generated invariant and runtime schema planes remain separate.
- [ ] No extension-owned executable code, arbitrary route/URL, template, or credential was introduced.
- [ ] Site/organization/workspace and cache bindings are explicit.
- [ ] Exact values avoid binary floating point.
- [ ] Logs, errors and fixtures contain no tokens, secrets or personal data.
- [ ] Mutation retry/concurrency behavior is unchanged or documented and tested.

- [ ] Generation is deterministic where applicable.
- [ ] Contract/core matrix fixtures pass where applicable.
- [ ] Negative, lifecycle and abuse cases cover the change.
- [ ] Documentation, status, roadmap and ADRs are consistent.
